name: talent-graph
install: bun install && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive node_modules/.bin/agent-browser install --with-deps && sudo ln -sfn "$PWD/node_modules/.bin/agent-browser" /usr/local/bin/agent-browser
start:
if ! agent-browser --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  bun install &&
  bin="$PWD/node_modules/.bin/agent-browser" &&
  if [ ! -x "$bin" ]; then
    dir="$HOME/.local/share/agent-browser-0.38.1" &&
    mkdir -p "$dir" &&
    printf '%s\n' '{"private":true,"dependencies":{"agent-browser":"0.38.1"},"trustedDependencies":["agent-browser"]}' > "$dir/package.json" &&
    bun install --cwd "$dir" &&
    bin="$dir/node_modules/.bin/agent-browser"
  fi &&
  DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive "$bin" install --with-deps &&
  sudo ln -sfn "$bin" /usr/local/bin/agent-browser
fi
